summary: This bill directs the Secretary of State to advocate for the inclusion and recognition of the Central Tibetan Administration in international bodies and to engage with its officials at high levels, treating them with diplomatic courtesies.

scores.thoughts: The bill mentions 'diverse programming to support health, education, humanitarian aid, governance, people-to-people exchanges' for Tibetan communities, authorized by previous acts. While it doesn't directly appropriate new funds, it reinforces existing support, which can be considered a form of foreign aid or assistance.
